recipe.edge_direction: dst_xyz-src_xyz; length in canonical normalized xyz; no second /L
recipe.cycle_weights: Nine distinct blocks; same block shared across four cycles
recipe.input: Original canonical xyz3 + all25 features including actual normalized force/moment6 + original1024 xyz-only PointNet global32; no force mask, alpha/u9 or sample ID.
recipe.target: Existing TRAIN-only encoded signed ux/uy/uz/scalar stress; complete original-node MSE/4, unchanged loss weights.
recipe.schedule: Existing stored480 case order, four full120-case PythonRandom2026 passes independent of model RNG; exactly four updates per known3 case.
recipe.gradient: Encode the complete mesh once per case; detach H0[N32] to leaf; all readout chunks node/N weighted; one original H0.backward(leaf.grad) and one Adam update. No repeated full mesh solve per chunk or cross-step trainable state cache.
recipe.checkpointing: Complete edge rows and full supports, edgechunk65536 plus activation checkpoint of messages/cycle states. No denseN2/E32x32, sampled/dropped edges, retained fullN aggregate per chunk or resource fallback.
recipe.precision: Same float32/TF32/high/noautocast as prior screen; physical decode and metrics float64.
recipe.selection: Fixed480 primary; knownVAL15 shared score0.5*(case-mean U relativeL2+signedstress relativeL2), best secondary; no training-best or dia selection.
recipe.timing: Comparable train starts before normalcase/target/cloud+hierarchy cache read/H2D and ends after full solve/readout/backward/Adam/sync. Shared target-free45CAD preparation separate. Inference starts after normal input/H2D; evaluationwall includes load, so fields overlap and must not be added as disjoint costs.

input_preparation.reuse: Import frozen prepare_topology_context and prepare_topology_context_balanced helpers without modifying originals; no redundant new graph toy or preliminary fourCAD fit.
input_preparation.node_order: Original canonical H5-vertex row order with existing GRID-coordinate alignment, not GRID_ID-1.
input_preparation.edges: Exact unique real TET10 corner-midpoint subedges; no guessed rigid/reference shortcuts or centroid-nearest edge replacement.
input_preparation.aggregation: balanced_owners same-role connected merges; perlevel hard maximum=current_level_N natural maximum; desired=max(soft2048or128,rolecomponentlowerbound). Variable actualN1/N2 preserved with connected BFS witness/cut multiplicities.
input_preparation.maps: Old hardmass R and complete positive two-pass J2P. Each W/R/P CSR row=dst receiver,col=src sender; dictionary src/dst/weight/delta_xyz=dstxyz-srcxyz/length/indptr/shape/torchCSR. Wcut divided by receiver weighteddegree, R/P original fullfloat32weights; no topk/threshold/cap/repair. xyz0/xyz1/xyz2 already normalized by originalL, never second/L.
input_preparation.resource_guard: The frozen helper rejects P support exceeding its average64nnz-per-fine-row resource allowance as completed/feasibility_false, without truncating or replacing support. A successful full45 input manifest is required before training; this resource guard is separate from naturalN ownership maxima.
input_preparation.physics_limits: Role flags are support-reference/interface descriptors, not nodeDirichlet; V/10 is corner-P1 volume proxy, not quadratic FE mass/stiffness; no PDE/strain target.
input_preparation.scope: One target-free45CAD canonicalver prep, shared across known3 and fixedDEVdia; old4outputs may reuse only documented matching algorithm/source/input identities; no downloads or Fieldlabel scan.

access.author: Source plus one AST/metadata check only; zero arrays/models/weights/CUDA
access.actual: Unique root serial queue after recipefreeze and necessary source review

first_actual_check: One true full-case train backward: complete H0/output shape, actualN0/N1/N2, parameter counts, finite positive encoder/lift/fine/down/up/coarse/readout gradient groups plus H0leaf; no toy or repeat scientificprobe. OOM/exception failed and preserves last checkpoint, no truncation/fallback.
checkpoint: Atomic last/best/step0,120,240,480; last firstupdate/every30; complete Adam/model/Python/NumPy/Torch/CUDA RNG/order/nextposition/case-node exposure/history/passcost/memory restore. Same config/science only, no warmstart.

development_dia.checkpoint: Completed fresh last.pt step480 only; config/order/exposure/source identity checked before weights; no route/best/seed selection
development_dia.inputs: Canonical xyz/nodeorder/nonforce19 exactly match ver; canonical xyzcloud/mask and hierarchy reused, actualdia load6 retained
development_dia.label_access: Only after all original nodes predicted and physically decoded; initial NPZ access onlyxyz/features
development_dia.scope: Previously explored DEV5-dia diagnostic; oldfinal/newsealed stay closed

limitations: One fresh fullmesh architecture, no paired mechanism or strict capacity claim
Static geometry feasibility does not prove training resources, learned stress/gradient/BC accuracy or elasticity
No P2 capability stage or strainhelper in this protocol; it would require a separate later rootfreeze
Previously explored DEV is development, not blindfinal generalization
